events.name: Bash
events.head: Check snapshot, log, push, test, job state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; ls pipeline/snapshots/; grep -n "2026-10-12" coord/LOG.md | grep -i "PIPELINE WEEKLY\|FEATURE WEEKLY" | cut -c1-200; date; git log origin/main --oneline -1; git show --stat 025b2fd4 | tail -8; python3 pipeline/test_dash.py 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 tasks/pass.py show T-158 2>/dev/null | grep -i -A3 evidence | head; launchctl list | grep pipeline-weekly

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect dash.py diff and task evidence
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; git show 025b2fd4 -- pipeline/dash.py | head -60; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read snapshot start and weekly job
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; sed -n 317,332p pipeline/dash.py; grep -n "def job\|FEATURE WEEKLY\|LOG.md\|strftime\|decisions" tasks/features/weekly.py | head -20; grep -n "StandardOutPath\|StandardErrorPath" -A1 ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check imports, DATA path, job log
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -n "^import\|^from" pipeline/dash.py | head; grep -n "^DATA\|DATA =" tasks/features/*.py | head -3; tail -12 pipeline/weekly.log | cut -c1-160

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun job under launchd and check no duplicates
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; P=$(lsof -ti:8899|head -1); echo server=$P; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly && echo kicked; for i in $(seq 1 40); do tail -1 pipeline/weekly.log | grep -q "$(date +%H:%M) · launch-control · PIPELINE" && break; sleep 3; done; tail -6 pipeline/weekly.log | cut -c1-120; grep -c "^2026-10-12.*FEATURE WEEKLY DECISION" coord/LOG.md; grep -c "^2026-10-12.*PIPELINE WEEKLY SNAPSHOT" coord/LOG.md; python3 pipeline/test_dash.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | cut -c1-80; git status --short coord/LOG.md pipeline/ tasks/features/data/
